shared_elements: curved incised bands (possibly garment hem or necklace lines)
low-relief carving of a clothed body/figure element
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces show a plain circular disc and curving incised bands over what may be the draped lower body of a figure, motifs any carving tradition could produce independently. B depicts a fully articulated two-figure scene — facing standing figures with elaborate coiffures, headgear, held bowls and whisk, fringed robes, feet and dense inscription — while A shows only a few isolated, schematic incised outlines with no identifiable figures, actions or relationships between elements.
